children: Pilgrim's Pride completed a private offering of €500 million in 4.750% senior notes due 2034, co-issued with Pilgrim's Europe Finance. The notes, issued under an indenture with Citibank, London Branch as trustee, pay interest annually each January 23 beginning in 2027 and mature on January 23, 2034. The unsecured senior obligations were sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Net proceeds will support general corporate purposes, including funding the Walkers Deli & Sausage Company acquisition and related costs.
